description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the original distribution of five emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages shown relative to the number of utterances. The chart is divided into five slices, each representing a distinct emotion: "Frustration" (25.1%, light blue), "Neutral" (23.1%, dark blue), "Happiness" (8.1%, light red), "Excitement" (14.1%, dark red), and "Sadness" (14.7%, orange). The "Anger" category is also labeled on the chart, but its corresponding slice is not shown, indicating it was not included in the final five categories. The percentages are displayed directly within each slice, and the chart visually represents the proportion of each emotion in the dataset.
